evidence: image: the 丨丨 headword marks are plainly printed throughout, e.g. '吾用汝嘉併超丨丨以昭忠義之勸', '敬丨丨有差', '馬有丨丨顏延之赭白馬賦', '周管稟丨丨也'; OCR drops every one ('吾用汝嘉併超 / 以昭忠義之勸', '而馬有 / 顏延'). In a phrase dictionary the 丨丨 is the headword itself, so each citation loses its key word. The scramble is also real: the image reads '陳其寔計功量罪' (end of the 并秩 citation) and '馬有丨丨顏延之赭白馬賦' (粟秩 citation). The OCR prints '顏延 / 寔計功量罪 / 之赭白馬賦', splicing the 并秩 tail into the middle of Yan Yanzhi's title.

image: '粟秩 說苑晉舅犯曰民有饑色而馬有丨丨' and then directly '顏延之赭白馬賦'. The source sentence ends at 'the horses have 粟秩 (grain rations)'. English: heading 'Full Rank' and '...while the horses have the appearance of fullness, the ruler cannot maintain his position.' The headword is mistranslated, and nothing on the leaf supports the closing clause.

image: '卑秩 論衡成王之才不如周公桓公之智不若管仲然成桓受尊命而周管稟丨丨也 張九齡詩晚節從丨丨…歐陽修詩…窮賤守丨丨' then '多秩 謝靈運詩辭滿豈丨丨岐路良非一…'. The English has no 卑秩 ('Lowly Rank') heading. The Lunheng, Zhang Jiuling and Ouyang Xiu citations go under 'Many Ranks' ('Zhou and Guan received the mandate of rank', 'keep my many ranks'), so the lowly/honoured contrast is lost. Xie Lingyun's 辭滿豈多秩 goes under 'Gracious Rank'. The shift is real.

image: '古無丨丨', '亦惟丨丨', '來膺丨丨', '分其丨丨', '宜丨丨', '筮仕無丨丨歸耕有外臣', etc. 丨丨 follows nearly every citation. The OCR omits all of them ('古無', '亦惟', '來膺'). It also adds junk characters from the margin ('金 贝 四 屋 今').

image: '中秩 盧照隣詩筮仕無丨丨歸耕有外臣' then '西秩 李嶠詩輝光射東井禁令橫丨丨 又貢奎詩…'. English: 'Middle Rank ... returning to farm, there is the / Outer Rank <note>local or provincial office</note> / Li Qiao poem ... / Western Rank / Gong Kui poem'. 外臣 ends Lu Zhaolin's line and is not a headword. The made-up heading also moves Li Qiao's citation away from 西秩, its real headword.

English: 'shield the world with a', 'it is fitting to add a', 'though he did not yet hold a'. The dangling endings are real and do mislead, because a reader cannot tell that the missing word is the headword above. But the cause is the OCR omission of 丨丨 (image: '庇世道丨丨', '宜加丨丨', '雖未居丨丨'), which r3-2-40-0 already counts. It is not O6, since no character was misread. Treat it as the same O5 defect carried into the translation, not a second independent serious error.

image: column 1 has '居清淨貧' in small type (the tail of the 散秩/Bai Juyi citation from p.40), then the headword '重秩 薛廷珪授王堅檢校兵部尚書制五兵丨丨式耀賔階'. English: '### Pure and Clean / ### Poor Rank / ... The Five Weapons are in **Pure and Clean** order'. The continuation line becomes two headings, the real headword 重秩 (heavy/important rank) is dropped, and 'Pure and Clean' is put in place of 丨丨 (= 重秩) inside the decree.

image: 'Iam nouies centum ter mille recursibus annos / Aureus explêrat Phœbus, terq; inde vicenos / Addiderat'. The OCR is correct. The sense is 900 + 3000 = 3,900 years, plus three times twenty (60), so 3,960 anno mundi. English: 'completed years by nine hundred times three thousand recursions, and had added twenty from there'. The multiplication and the dropped 'ter' give a wrong, garbled date for the Nativity, the point of the passage.

image line 1: 'solet iust' p h(oc) b(re)ve vic' sub nomine suo ex p(ar)te d(omi)ni r(egis)...'; line 2 'iust' ip(s)a auct(oritat)e ... vic' ex p(ar)te d(omi)ni r(egis)...'. OCR: 'solent inter personas libere vel nisi hoc esset expresse in scriptura. Item potest auctore iustitiario...'. Only 'solent' matches. The rest of the opening clause has no counterpart on the leaf.

image: rubric '...de seisina p(ro) concordia', then the blue/red initial 'Rex vic' salt'm. Scias q(uod) convenit in(ter) ... A. petente(m) et B. ten(entem) de tanto t(er)re cu(m) p(er)tin(entiis) i(n) tali villa'. OCR: 'Rex vicecomiti salutem. Summoneas per bonos summonitores A. quod sit coram iustitiariis nostris ad primam assisam...', a summons writ that is not on the leaf. The rubric 'Breve de tali summonitione si quis vocetur in eadem provincia' is also not what the red text says.

image col. 1 begins with no initial: 'de aliis dieb(us) ul' forte p(lu)res p(er) defectu recognitor(um) ul' p(er) essoniu(m) tenent(is) et ad diem illu(m) an(te) capc(i)o(n)em assis(e) venit Warant(us) et velit Warantizare et defend(er)e no(n) d(ebet) audiri'. The flourished S stands lower in the column ('Si a(utem) capta est assisa ad diem...'). OCR: '[initial S] Si alius vel uxor petat per sectam recognoverit vel per essonium tenens et ad diem illi anni captionem antequam venit Warantus velit Warantizare et defendere'. This is not a replacement from elsewhere. It shares 'per essonium tenen-', 'ad diem', 'captionem', 'venit Warantus velit Warantizare et defendere' with the leaf. The line is badly misread into a fluent but wrong sentence: the invented subject 'a wife who sues', a misplaced initial, and 'diem illi anni' for 'diem illum ante'. Serious, but O6 rather than O1.

image line 2: 'Anno r. f. r. h. vi. Com' [Midd'?] ass. m. a.' with no 'decimo nono' and no 'ad medium quadragesime'. OCR: 'Anno regis Henrici filii regis Iohannis decimo nono ad medium quadragesimae'. The regnal year vi becomes 'nineteenth', and the assize abbreviation 'ass. m. a.' (assisa mortis antecessoris) becomes a Lent date. The county in line 1 is also uncertain.

English: 'in the nineteenth year of King Henry, son of King John, at the middle of Lent'. It faithfully carries the OCR's invented date (the image has 'vi' and 'ass. m. a.'). A reader citing the case gets the wrong year and term, and the assize type is lost. This is the OCR error propagated, so it is not an independent translation fault.

image: a double-page woodcut of a garden scene (two women and a young man by water and a moon gate), not a map. The fore-edge margin label reads '題[紅]記' (紅 partly cut off at the left edge). The next text leaf (p.60) is drama dialogue with role marks (小生, 丑, 末) and the same margin title '題紅記' with '下卷'. The book record is titled 坤輿萬國全圖 (Ricci's world map), which these leaves are not.

image left leaf: each column appears once, e.g. '憂容必有緣故便得知…', '客舍并州已十霜歸心日夜憶咸陽無端更渡桑乾', '一舉成名了…'. OCR repeats lines ('憂容必有說故小弟沒奈何且為眉頭不展面韓' twice, '客舍并州已十霜…桑乾' twice, '一舉成年擾令尊大人…' twice), garbles them ('有說故' for '有緣故', '成年' for '成名'), and interleaves columns out of order.

English: 'Calculate you announce, Small Male: I want to beat Master Han, then use the Han... definitely must enter and report a visit.' It translates the scrambled OCR word by word into incoherent dialogue. The image's real lines ('…你去通報 (小生)…韓爺要打…') make sense, and the speaker turns are lost. A reader cannot recover the scene.
